description: This file defines classes, structures, and declarations related to engine control, including fuel scheduling, sensor states, engine state, and various hardware interfaces. It serves as a core header file for engine management firmware, with classes such as MockAdcState, FuelSchedule, SensorsState, EngineState, and Engine, encapsulating the main functionalities and data structures.

classes.name: MockAdcState
classes.description: Represents the state of mocked ADC channels, allowing setting mock voltages and retrieving ADC values for testing purposes.

classes.name: FuelSchedule
classes.description: Handles fuel injection event scheduling for engine cycles, enabling addition of fuel events per cylinder.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Provides calculations and curve preparations for thermistor temperature sensing.

classes.name: Accelerometer
classes.description: Represents 3-axis accelerometer data used in sensor state.

classes.name: SensorsState
classes.description: Aggregates sensor data such as temperature, oil pressure, accelerometer readings, voltage, AFR, and fuel gauge.

classes.name: FuelConsumptionState
classes.description: Tracks fuel consumption metrics and updates per cycle.

classes.name: TransmissionState
classes.description: Stores current gear state of the transmission.

classes.name: WarningCodeState
classes.description: Maintains warning codes, recent warnings, and related times.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Holds engine-specific state information, including timing, noise, knock, and various sensors.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Core class managing engine operations, including trigger handling, fuel injection, ignition, diagnostics, and overall engine state.

classes.name: StartupFuelPumping
classes.description: Manages startup fuel pumping logic based on TPS input.

methods.name: ThermistorMath
methods.description: Methods for setting config, preparing thermistor curve, and calculating temperature from resistance.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Constructors, initialization, and core methods such as periodic callbacks, trigger handling, resetting, and shutdown checks.

methods.name: StartupFuelPumping
methods.description: Constructor and update method for startup fuel pumping management.
